parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no member records, no field lists, no context flags, and all structural evidence fields (differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count) are null. Without any grounded evidence about the actual shape of PauseWXYC and ToggleWXYC beyond their file paths in Shared/Intents/Sources/Intents/, no defensible refactor recommendation can be formed. The signal that these two types form a subset-pair may be real, but the absence of member data makes it impossible to name moved members, a parent protocol, or a target location with the required precision.
